0022600096.text: Neither the Timberwolves nor the Magic has played a 2026-27 game yet, and Minnesota will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery. Orlando is missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Noah Penda (hamstring). Minnesota lost both meetings with Orlando in 2025-26, most recently 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026.
